Before you add this

These weights are Google\'s, under the Health AI Developer Foundations terms, and you agree to them here before anything is downloaded. The terms say they aren\'t for diagnosing or treating anyone, and this app does neither: it explains the words in a document you already hold, and says nothing about what they mean for you.
